subject.title: fix(scripts): bound ci-run-timings git and GitHub CLI operations

question: Should repository automation adopt the proposed 60-second duplicate-closeout deadline and 120-second CI/stable-closeout deadlines as the standard failure policy for these script owners?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow, but the selected limits intentionally change when healthy-but-slow operator workflows fail; that operational tradeoff needs maintainer acceptance.

options.title: Accept the bounded failure policy
options.body: Keep the proposed 60-second and 120-second budgets and merge once exact-head checks finish, preferring actionable timeout failures over unbounded workflow stalls.

options.title: Calibrate before merge
options.body: Ask for measured healthy-run timing evidence for duplicate closeout and adjust only the owner-local timeout constants if the present limits lack sufficient margin.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded failure policy
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed 60-second and 120-second budgets and merge once exact-head checks finish, preferring actionable timeout failures over unbounded workflow stalls.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged adjacent timeout work provides the closest established repository precedent for these operational budgets.
